nodes.descriptionHtml:
All-white raglan baseball tee — white body, white raglan sleeves cut on the diagonal seam, white ribbed crew and small LUCSUM chest mark.

Be your own universe.

Product details

  • 100% cotton jersey
  • Oversized relaxed fit
  • Baseball / raglan sleeve construction with diagonal seams
  • White body · white raglan sleeves · white ribbed crew
  • Small LUCSUM chest branding
  • Colorway: White/White
  • Price: ₹899
